title: MetaFunction
summary: Compute metadata from the active loader snapshot.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: A function from MetaArgs<T> to MetaDescriptor[]. Meta calls the active route function when present and otherwise falls back to root metadata.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: An empty array intentionally suppresses fallback root metadata. Metadata functions should derive values from their arguments and must not start network requests.
